meaning: 规则加仓分数：预先固定因子加权和，表达规则定义的价格折让/恐慌回落强度；不是胜率，也没有证据表明单独分数优于VIX旧规则。

input.USD: SOXX actual USD adjusted close, not synthetic USD history
input.VIX: Cboe VIX and VIX3M strictly earlier than decision day; max7 calendar day old
input.price: latest same-day close permitted, order fixed then fills next common close; max7calendar day old
input.warmup: 252 closes for high and MA;252 earlier complete MA ratios for S;21 and126 log returns for volatility family;252 earlier VIX observations for F. Missing required data =>score null and no new order, never assumed50 or0.

S.label: 历史相对低位
S.normalized: (number of earlier1260 valid ratios greater than raw +0.5*equal)/valid earlier count

F.label: 恐慌水平
F.normalized: fraction of earlier1260 VIX observations below raw

score.weightOrigin: Fixed before first36-candidate run; not fitted regression or calibrated probabilities. The delivered3 methods chosen after seeing all36+18 results and are exploratory.

execution.firstBuy: Each configured USD/TQQQ budget buys90% immediately, remaining10% stays attributed to that leg; deep choice buys80% and retains20%. Original unallocated cash and other assets remain outside policy.
execution.scoreBuy: If valid score >=threshold and sleeve risk gate on, spend sleeveCash*clamp((score-threshold+10)/(110-threshold),0,1); buy notional=spend/(1+fee). Fix budget now, fill next common close. Recalculate only after pending order fills. If remaining sleeve cash <initialAccountValue*0.0001, spend entire sleeve cash.
execution.cashSource: Only that leg initial retained reserve plus its sale proceeds and assigned deposits; no borrowing; no phantom new funding for repeated high scores.
execution.TQQQExit: Frozen originalVIX: previous knownVIX/VIX3M>1.1 for10 observations while armed ->sell allTQQQ next common close; proceeds attributedTQQQ.
execution.TQQQReopen: After at least5 off observations,VIX<=70%off-periodpeak OR ratio<1 for5observations ->gateon. Score still controlsactual subsequent purchase amount.
execution.USDExit: No sell purely due to low score. USD sleeve always on while necessary inputs valid.
execution.rearm: After VIX recovery, need ratio<1 for5observations before nextpanicexit can arm.
execution.contribution: Any actual configured new contribution increases assigned leg cash and follows identical score rule; historical comparison useszero contribution. Do not convert score into repeating deposits.

example.note: score65 means53.33%of currentlegreserve thisexecution, not65%account andnot65%win probability.
